source_scope.value: sum of positive source-native N ind by COMMUNITY x visita x Pollinator, pooled across plant rows
source_scope.partner_id: source-native Pollinator label after whitespace normalization only
source_scope.zero_rule: blank Pollinator rows with N ind=0 establish sampled flowering-plant census effort but create no pollinator value; missing COMMUNITY x visita combinations are not imputed

effort_contract.definition: Within each observed obs COMMUNITY x visita, identify each source-native censo once and sum its unique positive Delta_T_minutes. Duplicate interaction rows within a censo do not multiply effort.

prohibited_after_freeze: change primary method away from obs
change COMMUNITY as the stable system identifier
merge or split source-native visita bins after seeing D1 or phi
include Pine forest 1 despite the six-bin floor
drop an admitted community based on its coordinate
change interaction value away from N ind
count duplicated interaction rows as additional observation effort
replace the frozen censo-duration effort with an outcome-dependent normalization
claim_boundary: Five Cabrera communities are repeated local systems within one source study and one archipelago group. Their admission is based only on source structure, reconstructible observation duration, time-bin count and nonconstant partner-series count. No D1, phi, rho_eq or route result was opened before this freeze.
